title: Kagamine Len — Joint Training!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Emu and the others seem to be working really hard!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. Their practices sound really tough, but I'm really looking forward to seeing how she plays Ushiwakamaru♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too! Also, what do you think them doing a historical drama is gonna be like?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are they gonna say things like, “Make way! Make way for the constabulary☆”...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't think that's what their story's about...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, you guys, do you have a minute...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I have a quick question since we're talking about these kinds of historical dramas...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What if we did one together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Us?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. I sorta really want to now after hearing what Emu and the others are doing!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I like your thinking!
Count me in.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too. It sounds like fun.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Alright, that settles that☆
Let's start by deciding what kind of story we're gonna do♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Awesome! Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The samurai help people along the way and battle against the big, bad ogre... Sounds like a fun and exciting show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Good luck as the hero, Len☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks, but I'm gonna need to practice a lot!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, let's start practicing our sword fighting.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The three of us will be the ones primarily involved in those scenes, MEIKO, Len, so let's try practicing together.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, the rest of us will watch.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, I'll go grab the practice swords!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: “Hiyah!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That last one felt very powerful.
Your step and swing occurred simultaneously.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It really felt like you could send the big, bad ogre's sword flying!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really? Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Good for you, Len.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Next, KAITO, it's you and me!
Which scene would you like to do?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, how about the scene where my character comes face to face with the ogre for the very first time...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa, this tension...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, everything's at a standstill...
This is nothing like the stunts and stuff we usually do...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(And nothing like what I just did...
Is this what a sword fight in a historical drama's supposed to feel like?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I wanna learn how to do that.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Phew... Nice work.
The tension we created was good, but I feel like we can make things feel more dynamic by using more space...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Agreed!
Let's try doing that next!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Uh, hey... MEIKO! KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Umm... That last fight...
Can you guys show me how to do what you just did?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: How to do that...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I was on the edge of my seat the whole time...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That tension in the air. That sense of one false step and you're done for. You guys had my heart racing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wanna learn how to do that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But that won't be easy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Between staring your opponent down and making very subtle movements, many different techniques go into making a fight like this look real.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which includes how to properly swing a sword.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Right...
It did look really hard...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But I still wanna try.
I'm playing the lead, so I feel that I need to do my best...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, that's all I need to hear!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, let's come up with a special training regimen for Len!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A special training regimen?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes! If he wants to learn how to put on a convincing sword fight, then he'll need to master the right etiquette and techniques!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But it's pretty boring work, so I hope you're prepared for that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Boring? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: For example, practicing your downswing over and over or learning how to change your stance based on what your opponent does. Also, meditating while sitting in the correct position!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As you get used to holding a sword and learn what to do during the periods of brief calm, your sword fighting skills should start naturally improving.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Although, I feel that he should be allowed to sit however he wants when he meditates...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, in order to make our dreams come true, let's make our play about Ushiwakamaru a good one.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, let's all do some of those exercises again together!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Starting from the top of the Kijima Special! Sprinting at full speed! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Emu and the others are doing their best right now, so I...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I should also be doing what I can to put on the performances that I want!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll do it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If that'll help me put on calm but cool battles like you guys just did, I wanna do it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Len...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, it might be good for us to learn and review all the fundamentals...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, I'll join you. Let's learn together...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: KAITO...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's get started and do what we can until our show!
